# Copilot instructions — AnnualPDHours

Use the repository's [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) and `docs/` reference files as the authoritative requirements. Always read `docs/CALCULATION_RULES.md` before editing calculation or holiday code. The app has two navigation entries, Hours Calculator and PD Magic 8-Ball; the dashboard is the submitted calculator's results view. It is 100% client-side and must deploy to GitHub Pages. Current billability is entered as a percentage and converted to estimated billable hours using the elapsed denominator. Do not invent official Terraphase utilization or holiday-observation rules. Prioritize accessible React+TypeScript components, pure tested date/math utilities, and clear input validation. Keep inputs in browser-local storage only. Avoid unnecessary dependencies and backend services.
